// diagnostic

E0216

`` `SharedGuard.split` needs two disjoint field projections ``.

What

`` `SharedGuard.split` needs two disjoint field projections ``.

Why

Two child guards must preserve non-overlapping provenance under one original lock. Equal, enclosing, nested, or computed projections cannot prove that law.

Fix

Project two stored sibling fields, such as `value.left` and `value.right`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0216: tests/ui/shared_guard_split_overlap.stderr.

Error [E0216]: `SharedGuard.split` needs two disjoint field projections
  --> tests/ui/shared_guard_split_overlap.jet:9:16
    |
  9 |     _ :: guard.split(value => value.left, value => value.left)
    |                ^^^^^
 Why: two editable guards may never point at the same field or at an enclosing and nested field
 Fix: project sibling fields, such as `value.left` and `value.right`
